S1.name: Main Menu
S1.note: The game's main menu. The attract-mode demos return to it when they finish, which is why anything points here at all.

F2.4: Trial of the Rolling Boulder II
F2.7: Trial of the Swinging Boulder II

6.name: Boiler Room Revisited
6.note: Pixel-identical to the boiler room in P3 across all fifteen screens: the same rooms, restocked for the escape.

2.name: The Jungles of Necrum
2.note: The secret area in the jungle is built from Slig Barracks artwork, which the game does not reach for another four levels.

5.name: Necrum Vaults Hub
5.note: Its secret area is dressed as the Slig Barracks, status board and all.

NE.7: Path to the Vaults II: Fleeches

2.name: Trial 1
2.note: The trial's secret area is furnished as a corner of SoulStorm Brewery, with four Mudokons among the bone drills and two brewery status boards on the wall.

8.name: Trial 4
8.note: A brewery room hidden in the vault: three Mudokons behind an electric fence, in SoulStorm Brewery's artwork rather than the vault's.

11.name: Vault Exit
11.note: Both screens are Necrum Mines artwork, so the vault lets you out into scenery from where the game began.

14.name: Trial 4: Secret Area
14.note: Dressed as FeeCo Depot, two of its status boards included: a railway depot two levels away, tucked inside a Paramite trial.

15.name: Trial 3: Secret Area
15.note: Borrowed scenery from SoulStorm Brewery: three Mudokons among five bone drills.

1.name: Terminal 1
1.note: The secret area here is SoulStorm Brewery artwork, and one of the terminal's three status boards is a brewery board rather than a FeeCo one.

3.name: Terminal 3: Slig Barracks
3.note: The only terminal the artwork never numbers. Terminals 1, 2, 4 and 5 are each signed somewhere, so this one is 3 by elimination.

7.name: Annex 1
7.note: One of the annex's secret areas teleports you into SoulStorm Brewery artwork, a whole level away from Bonewerkz.

9.name: Zulag 11
9.note: The arch over the exit door reads ZULAG 14 while the status board in the same room reads 11: the same signage slip as zulag 13.

20.name: Zulag 13
20.note: The status boards through this stretch misprint the zulag as 14, a developer error corrected for the Japanese Abe '99 release.
